questions.prompt: Какой вариант использует reversed wh-cleft с фокусом *the main problem* в начале?

choices.text: It's the main problem that we ignored.
The main problem is what we ignored.
What we ignored is the main problem.
The main problem is that we ignored it.

questions.explanation: Фокус *the main problem* стоит перед связкой, а wh-clause — после неё.

questions.prompt: Как передать reversed wh-cleft: «Именно тебе я доверяю»?

choices.text: It's the person I trust that you are.
You are the person I trust.
Who I trust is you.
The person I trust is the one.

questions.explanation: В reversed wh-cleft фокус *you* стоит в начале; базовый порядок был бы *The person I trust is you*.

questions.prompt: Как передать reversed wh-cleft: «Именно с тобой мне нужно поговорить»?

choices.text: It's the one I need to speak to that is you.
The one I need to speak to is it.
You are the one I need to speak to.
What I need to speak to is the one.

questions.explanation: Фокус *you* вынесен перед связкой: *You are the one I need to speak to*.

questions.prompt: Как передать reversed wh-cleft: «Именно ответ, который вы дали, мне нужен»?

choices.text: It's the answer I need that you gave.
The answer I need is you.
The answer you gave is what I need.
What I need is the answer.

questions.explanation: Фокус *the answer you gave* стоит перед связкой, wh-clause *what I need* — после неё.

questions.prompt: Как передать reversed wh-cleft: «Именно больше времени мне было нужно»?

choices.text: It's the reason I left that I needed.
The reason I left is it.
The reason I left is what I needed.
More time is what I needed.

questions.explanation: Фокус *more time* вынесен в начало перед *is what I needed*.

questions.prompt: Как передать reversed wh-cleft: «Именно тихое кафе было местом, где я остановился»?

choices.text: It's the place I visited that is beautiful.
The place I visited is it.
Where I stayed was the quiet cafe.
The quiet cafe was where I stayed.

questions.explanation: В d фокус *the quiet cafe* стоит перед связкой; c показывает базовый порядок wh-cleft.

questions.prompt: Как передать reversed wh-cleft: «Именно с тобой я разговаривал»?

choices.text: It's the person I spoke to that is helpful.
You are the person I spoke to.
The person I spoke to is who I spoke to.
The person I spoke to is the one I spoke to.

questions.explanation: Фокус *you* вынесен в начало перед определяющей частью *the person I spoke to*.

questions.prompt: Как передать reversed wh-cleft: «Именно эта книга мне нужна»?

choices.text: It's the book I read that is interesting.
The book I read is interesting.
This book is what I need.
What I read is the book.

questions.explanation: Фокус *this book* стоит перед связкой; wh-clause *what I need* — после неё.

questions.prompt: Как передать reversed wh-cleft: «Именно в тот вечер мы встретились»?

choices.text: It's the moment we met that was special.
The moment we met is it.
The moment we met is when we met.
That evening is when we met.

questions.explanation: Фокус времени *that evening* вынесен в начало перед *is when we met*.

questions.prompt: Как передать reversed wh-cleft: «Именно бюджет мы проигнорировали»?

choices.text: It's the problem we ignored that is big.
The problem we ignored is it.
The budget is what we ignored.
The problem we ignored is the main issue.

questions.explanation: Фокус *the budget* стоит перед связкой; wh-clause *what we ignored* — после неё.
